name: Dover House
text: Dover House is a Grade I-listed mansion in Whitehall, and the London headquarters of the Scotland Office. The building also houses the Office of the Advocate General for Scotland and the Independent Commission for Aid Impact.

depictions.name: Dover House
depictions.text: The Dover House, previously known as Melbourne House is a mansion in London, England.
